newsitem.title: USA: DualStar Technologies names Birnbach CFO.
newsitem.headline: DualStar Technologies names Birnbach CFO.

text.p: DualStar Technologies Corp said on Tuesday Robert Birnbach would replace Stephen Yager as chief financial officer, effective immediately, due to structural changes at the company.

The company said it was merging two of its operating companies, Mechanical Associates Inc and Centrifugal Associates Inc. Both offer mechanical contracting services for heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems.
Ronald Fregara, formerly president of Mechanical Associates, would become the chief operating officer of the combined units, DualStar said.
Yager would step down from the CFO position, the company said. The company was not immediately available to say what Birnbach's previous position had been.
The company also said it was moving its corporate headquarters to Long Island City, N.Y. from Manhattan.
